messages:
harper (docs): FYI I opened a focused PR to clarify SOC2-related wording for audit logs, retention windows, and SDK config keys: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/359. Need a quick sanity check on phrasing for hosted vs Dedicated.

alex (security): Skimmed it. Please avoid absolutes (no "we never" language). Say: 'stored in accordance with our retention policy and deleted on schedule'. Also call out redaction limitations.

marta (legal): +1. Add a line that customers can negotiate extended retention in their contract and that Dedicated/Private give admin controls to set retention.

kai (devex): I updated the SDK snippet to use v2 keys. Example below — can someone confirm this maps to runtime behavior?

kai (devex): ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=TOKEN)
# v2 SDK flags: disable capturing raw inputs and request server-side redaction
client.config.audit.capture_user_input = False
client.config.audit.request_redaction = True
```

ryan (eng): That matches runtime. Note: the server still records metadata like `audit:user_id_hash` and `audit:event` even when capture_user_input=False. Add a short note.

harper (docs): Good catch — I'll add a short bullet list of internal log keys so ops/legal can map things: `audit:event`, `audit:user_id_hash`, `audit:payload_redacted`, `audit:tenant_kms_id`.

alex (security): Also add: data-at-rest encryption (AES-256) and per-tenant KMS for Dedicated. And a caveat: redaction may not remove sensitive bytes inside attachments or binary blobs.

marta (legal): For hosted retention we suggest stating default 90 days, with an opt-in longer term under contract. Please don't present this as a security guarantee; call it a policy.

harper (docs): Will reword to 'policy' and add a tiny table: Hosted default: 90 days; Dedicated: customer-configurable via admin console; Private: customer-managed.

kai (devex): One more thing: include a migration blurb for customers moving from SDK v1 to v2: map `record_user_input` -> `capture_user_input`, and `redact_user_input` -> `request_redaction`.

compliance-bot: label "docs/soc2" applied to PR #359 by automation.

ryan (eng): LGTM from runtime perspective. If legal signs off we can merge.

harper (docs): Thanks all 10I'll push the wording update and snapshot the final snippet in the SDK quickstart after approvals.

marta (legal): Reviewing now, will post one small wording tweak in PR comments.
